title: Fraud Ring
description: Bank customers who look unrelated in a table, but share a phone, a device and an address, and pass money in a circle.

questions.question: Which customers share a phone, device or address?
questions.cypher:
MATCH (a:Customer)-[r]->(shared)<-[r2]-(b:Customer)
WHERE a.name < b.name AND type(r) = type(r2)
RETURN a.name AS customer_a, b.name AS customer_b, type(r) AS link, labels(shared)[0] AS shared

questions.question: Is there a circle of money transfers?
questions.cypher:
MATCH p = (a:Account)-[:TRANSFERRED_TO*3..5]->(a)
RETURN [n IN nodes(p) | n.number] AS cycle, reduce(total = 0, r IN relationships(p) | total + r.amount) AS total_moved
LIMIT 1

questions.question: Which customers form one ring, linked through shared details?
questions.cypher:
MATCH (start:Customer {name: 'R. Mehta'})-[:USES_PHONE|USES_DEVICE|LIVES_AT*1..6]-(other:Customer)
WHERE other <> start
RETURN DISTINCT start.name AS seed, other.name AS linked_customer
